definition: One acquired resistance-gene occurrence: a single determinant call at a single coordinate interval on a single replicon in a single assembly.
question_it_answers: the resistome -- what fraction of resistance genes is where
notes: PRIMARY. Plasmid share on this denominator is 52.736 %.

definition: One shared chromosomal context block: the union of the +/-10 kb windows of the chromosomal occurrences that overlap on one replicon. A block carries 1 or more occurrences; marker-positive blocks carry 2.46 on average against 1.23 for marker-negative blocks.
question_it_answers: neighbourhoods -- what fraction of chromosomal neighbourhoods is mobile
notes: Chromosomal MGE association on this denominator is 30.14 %, against 46.39 % occurrence-weighted. Neither is wrong; they answer different questions.

definition: One ARG-bearing plasmid replicon, typed once for relaxase, MPF and oriT.
question_it_answers: plasmid architecture -- what fraction of ARG-bearing plasmids is conjugative
notes: Used for the mobility typing and cargo-convergence results.

definition: One event per (assembly, compartment): each genome contributes AT MOST one plasmid event and AT MOST one chromosomal event, regardless of how many resistance genes it carries in that compartment. 3,569 plasmid events + 6,186 chromosomal events = 9,755 across 6,288 genomes.
question_it_answers: the average isolate -- how often is a compartment used at all
notes: Plasmid share on this denominator is 3,569 / 9,755 = 36.586 %. This is NOT the mean of per-genome percentages, which is 35.932 % and is a different statistic. Quoting 36.586 % as an average of percentages is an error.

definition: One sequencing project. Used only as the resampling cluster for every bootstrap interval, never as an analysis denominator.
question_it_answers: uncertainty -- how much of an effect is one submitting group
notes: Effective count by 1/HHI is 136.9, far below the nominal 2,248.
